result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: one major layout problem where content is obscured by the bottom navigation, and one minor clipping issue in the horizontal restaurant carousels.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section is cut off by the fixed bottom navigation bar, so part of the content is hidden and not fully accessible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/scroll spacing to the content area or adjust the fixed nav bar so list items are not covered when scrolled near the bottom.

issues.description: The rightmost items in the horizontal restaurant rows are visibly clipped at the screen edge, making them look partially cut off.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel has proper horizontal padding or allow a clearer partial-card preview so the clipping looks intentional and cleaner.
